planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; authoritative wiring requires PWM output on D9 for the serial-controlled LED brightness.
Serial input is implemented as a bounded integer receiver at 9600 baud with framing line_or_idle and idle_timeout_ms=20 per given configuration.
Echo is implemented as a numeric serial report gated by a model boolean trigger; actual echo cadence/condition belongs in the SysML model.
No additional wired pins were supplied beyond D9; no other device requests are generated.

The original requirement includes '回显' (echo). Since no explicit report cadence/condition was provided, a single gated numeric echo value is registered and the exact gating logic is assumed to be defined in the model.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED brightness commanded by serial input (0..255), and used for any model-required re-echo consistency

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Serial input command 0..255 controlling PWM LED brightness on D9; valid event occurs for one model step

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Business condition to echo the last valid serial command value back over Serial (same report gate used for both numeric reports if required)
